summary:
ORBYNTRA, is an interactive tool platform designed to simplify the exploration and analysis behind environmental data. Its aim is to make scientific information about different environmental factors more accessible and understandable to students, teachers, and individuals interesting in learning more and accessing different data.
The website includes several features, such as Variable Detective, which explains environmental variables, their trends and limitations, and Regional Time Series, which visualizes changes in environmental factors over time. Its Trend Analysis feature examines annual trends and their statistical significance. Additionally, users can select two geographical regions and compare them using a chosen environmental factor. ORBYNTRA further expands regional contrast analysis through comparative data graphs and interactive visualizations, allowing users to identify differences between regions more effectively, seeing how each factor compares between different categories such as agriculture and greenery in vegetation, by using comparison graphs of climate change and its sections.
By combining environmental data analysis, statistical interpretation and interactive displays, ORBYNTRA goes beyond simply presenting maps. It helps users investigate what is changing, where changes are occurring and how different regions compare, encouraging a deeper understanding of environmental trends.
details:
Project Details – ORBYNTRA

ORBYNTRA is a website-based platform developed to make environmental data easier to understand, explore and analyze. The main purpose of the project is to help students, teachers and people interested in science understand how the environment changes over time using scientific data. Instead of simply showing environmental maps, ORBYNTRA allows users to explore different environmental factors, identify patterns and understand what the data tells us.

The platform allows users to select environmental variables, geographical regions and time periods for their investigations. The Variable Detective feature explains the selected variable, including its meaning, measurement units, data coverage and limitations. Users can also explore regional time-series graphs to see how environmental conditions change over time. Data quality indicators, such as missing values and quality flags, help users understand the reliability of the information.

One of the main features of ORBYNTRA is Statistical Trend Analysis. It calculates the trend slope per year, uncertainty and statistical significance to help users understand whether an environmental change represents a meaningful long-term trend or a normal fluctuation. Even trends that are not statistically significant are shown, as not every change in a graph represents a meaningful pattern. Earth Mirror provides another way to explore environmental information visually, while the planned Contrast Discovery Engine will allow users to compare geographical regions and identify differences in environmental trends.

 

ORBYNTRA has several benefits, including making environmental information more accessible, encouraging scientific thinking and improving users’ data analysis skills. It also encourages users to consider data quality and statistical evidence before making conclusions. The project is mainly intended for high-school and university students, teachers and citizen scientists. Its aim is to support environmental education and help people better understand real-world environmental challenges.

During the development of ORBYNTRA, we used artificial intelligence as an assisting tool. ChatGPT helped with brainstorming, research, organizing ideas and understanding technical concepts. We also explored scientific platforms such as NASA Giovanni for environmental and satellite-based data, Google Earth for geographical exploration, Climate Reanalyze for climate visualizations and Global Forest Watch for information about forest cover and deforestation. Digital tools and software were also used to design and develop the website and its features.

The creativity of ORBYNTRA comes from bringing different stages of scientific investigation together in one platform. Rather than only displaying maps and graphs, it allows users to explore variables, check data quality, identify changes and analyze environmental trends. During development, we considered scientific accuracy, accessibility, ease of use and data reliability. Overall, ORBYNTRA aims to make complex environmental information easier to understand and encourage people to learn more about the changes happening to our planet.
